hypothesis.thesis: Cross-currency funding stress is transmitting into carry unwinds across the current window.
hypothesis.uncertainty: Wide; conditional on quarter-end funding rollover.
hypothesis.whyNow: The basis and carry both dislocated within the same current evidence window.
hypothesis.trigger: The basis breaches its prior wide with a confirmed carry drawdown.
hypothesis.invalidation: The basis normalizes to its one-year median for five consecutive sessions.
hypothesis.monitoring: Track the funding basis band and the two owner reads daily.
hypothesis.resolution: The alert resolves when the basis and carry both re-anchor to prior ranges.
